messages:
emma (CSM): Quick check-in on Silverpine private/VPC deploy — customer says they're blocked on two items: KMS key policy (can't encrypt logs) and missing route to our infra peering. Can we confirm status? cc @raj (SE) @li (NetOps)

raj (SE): Looking. I saw their VPC peering request accepted but routes weren't propagated to the private-subnet route table. li, did you apply the route propagation?

li (NetOps): Not yet — held for approval because their CIDR overlaps a legacy subnet in their prod account. Reached out to Silverpine yesterday to pick a non-overlapping /24. Awaiting confirmation.

emma (CSM): Got it. Silverpine said they can pick a new /24 today if that helps avoid delays — they're anxious about the renewal checklist.

raj (SE): Cool. On KMS: they tried to add our service principal to the key policy but got AccessDenied. Sophie, do we need to provide a specific IAM role ARN or a setup snippet?

sophie (Security): We need the exact principal and the minimal policy. Use the service principal `arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-vpc-proxy` (replace REDWOOD_ACCOUNT with our account id). Also they must enable Grant tokens for Encrypt/Decrypt and PutObject if they're writing logs to S3. Sample policy:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "RedwoodKVAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-vpc-proxy"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

emma (CSM): Sending that snippet to Silverpine now. I'll also attach the exact ARN so they can paste.

raj (SE): For the route propagation, once they confirm new CIDR I can push the peer route entries from our side. Typical commands we run:```bash
# on our route table
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc123 --destination-cidr-block 10.50.8.0/24 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0def456
```

li (NetOps): FYI we need them to advertise the prefix on their side and accept the peering route. I'll schedule a 15min screenshare with their network engineer after they pick the CIDR. ETA: today EOD if they confirm.

emma (CSM): Thanks. One more ask from their infra lead: audit logs must go to their central S3 bucket with object locks enabled. Sophie, any compliance flags?

sophie (Security): Object lock is fine as long as we can write with the KMS key they designate. We also need them to enable CloudTrail for the account that hosts the VPC and grant our log delivery role `arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-log-uploader` PutObject permission on the bucket. Example bucket policy snippet I can paste.

emma (CSM): Perfect. I'll bundle the KMS policy + bucket policy + next steps and post in the support ticket. Suggestion: propose a 48hr target to complete peering + KMS so we don't slip renewal milestone. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj (SE): 48hrs seems reasonable assuming they pick CIDR today. If they delay, escalate to SOC for temporary exception?

sophie (Security): If they delay >72hrs and customer is blocked on production rollout, we can allow a controlled temporary key rotation exemption with manual audit logging. But prefer to avoid.

li (NetOps): I'll mark status: waiting-on-customer (CIDR) and create a calendar invite for a 15m handoff.

emma (CSM): Great — I'll follow up with Silverpine now. Will post updates here. cc @audit-bot to log the enablement checkpoint.

audit-bot: [recorded] enablement_checkpoint: customer=Silverpine, stage=KMS+peering, owner=emma (CSM), due=1799090000

emma (CSM): Update 2h later — Silverpine selected 10.50.128.0/24 and attached the peering accepter. li, you can proceed when ready.

li (NetOps): Pushing routes now. Confirmed route propagation. Both sides see each other. :white_check_mark:

raj (SE): I ran a quick end-to-end test — can reach the private control plane, and KMS encrypt/decrypt succeeds after they applied the policy. Logs are landing in their S3 test bucket.

emma (CSM): This is a win. I'll close the enablement ticket and note the renewal risk decreased. We'll keep the post-ship security review scheduled in two weeks. Thanks team :tada:
